description: This file defines localization parameters for the Arabic (Jordan) culture in a date handling library, likely DateJS. It specifies cultural info such as day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date to zero, effectively clearing the time portion.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time components to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a given weekday.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to the specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the day within the year.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation of the date.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone based on an offset.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date's timezone observes daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time is currently observed.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed since the date to now.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Outputs the date in ISO 8601 string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides default string representation with formatted date string.
